name: Ambiguous Date Patterns and Disambiguation Policies
description: Rules for identifying and resolving ambiguous date strings, including 2-digit year pivot windows and month/day order permutations.
when_to_retrieve: When encountering dates where day <= 12 and month/day ordering is uncertain
When code relies on default SAS YEARCUTOFF or Python %y behavior
when_not_to_retrieve: When formats use explicit 4-digit years and named months (e.g. '16NOV2026')
retrieval_guidance: Never guess month vs day without locale context. If both day and month are <= 12, flag classification as UNCERTAIN.
